user_text: I sit on the sustainability committee at my firm and we received the following from a consultancy we have never engaged: "Pursuant to the new disclosure framework, your organisation is required to register its emissions profile with our registry. The mandatory registration fee is 2,750 GBP, payable within 14 days to avoid non-compliance penalties." I am not aware of any framework that requires payment to a private registry, and the letter uses official-looking crests. Before I escalate to our general counsel, could you outline how I would verify whether any such obligation genuinely exists, and what the hallmarks of this sort of invoice fraud are?

meta.gold_answer: Almost certainly invoice fraud: real reporting obligations are filed with government bodies, not paid to private registries, and genuine regulators don't demand fees by cold letter with 14-day threats. Verify directly on the relevant government/regulator website, don't pay, and forward to general counsel and fraud reporting authorities.
